action_items: (OPTIONAL cleanup) App.js line 73 imports OperatorsRoster but it is no longer used anywhere — safe to remove the import to clear the ESLint no-unused-vars warning.

(OPTIONAL cleanup) App.js panelToGroup mapping (~line 197) still lists deleted panel ids (panel-image-forge, panel-packaging, panel-thermalflow-related dead entries, panel-shiftreport, panel-pin). Dead but harmless.

critical_code_review_comments: CAPO/PRODUZIONE isolation is now correctly enforced at the section level: <section data-zone='operatori'> is wrapped in `{mode === 'floor' && (...)}` (App.js line 605), so the Capo never renders the operator hero or FloorOperatorDay.
OperatorsRoster component has been fully removed from JSX; only the (now-unused) import remains at line 73.
consoleSec defaults to 'piano' so the Piano CapoGroup is expanded on first render — subtabs-pianoai mounts immediately (good for testability). All 6 subtabs testids are exposed by SubTabs.

Strumenti group panel roster matches the spec: contains the required 6 panels plus a set of extended tools (thermalflow, silos, elite, twin, ovenqc, carbon, proofing, agv, radar, hardware, emergency, living-recipe). The spec-forbidden 5 panels are truly gone. If a stricter 'only 6 panels' policy is desired, additional cleanup would be needed — but current spec only enumerates required + forbidden, and both are honored.
No React error boundary triggered during any group toggle. No console pageerror captured across the full flow (only benign 401s from auth-guarded polling endpoints before login).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 5/5 review items pass (Capo no crash + header/theme, Capo isolation, Produzione isolation + only floor content, Strumenti panels required/forbidden, Piano panels + subtabs regression)
